entities.name: Jimmy Van Heusen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: James Van Heusen was an American composer. He wrote songs for films, television, and theater, and won an Emmy and four Academy Awards for Best Original Song. Many of his compositions later went on to become jazz standards.
